title: Install Ollama
description: Installs Ollama as a system service the way Ollama's own Linux instructions do, without touching GPU drivers, then downloads the chosen model.

bind.description: Address Ollama listens on. 127.0.0.1 means only this machine (and the app, through SSH).

contextLength.description: How much conversation the model keeps in view, in tokens.

keepAlive.description: How long a model stays loaded after its last use.

ollamaVersion.description: The Ollama release this recipe was tested with. 'latest' takes the newest at download time.

ollamaSha256.description: sha256 of ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst for that release, as GitHub publishes it. Empty means record without checking.

model.description: Model to download after installing, for example qwen3:0.6b.

preflight.title: systemd is running
preflight.failMessage: This machine does not run systemd, which the Ollama service needs.

preflight.title: 64-bit x86 machine
preflight.failMessage: Only x86_64 machines are supported for now.

preflight.title: Can look up github.com
preflight.failMessage: This machine cannot resolve github.com, where Ollama is downloaded from. Check its internet connection and DNS.

preflight.title: Port 11434 is free or already Ollama
preflight.run: if ss -ltnH 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | grep -q ':11434$'; then systemctl is-active --quiet ollama; fi
preflight.failMessage: Something other than Ollama is already using port 11434.

steps.title: Install curl and zstd if they are missing
steps.why: curl downloads Ollama and zstd unpacks it.
steps.skipIf: command -v curl >/dev/null && command -v zstd >/dev/null && command -v tar >/dev/null
steps.run:
apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 -o Acquire::Retries=3 update -qq
apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 -o Acquire::Retries=3 install -y -qq --no-install-recommends curl zstd tar ca-certificates

steps.title: Download Ollama
steps.why: About 1.5 GB. Runs in the background on the server, so it keeps going if your phone sleeps, and it resumes if interrupted.
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$P_CACHE"
cd "$P_CACHE"
if [ "$P_ollamaVersion" = latest ]; then
    url=$(curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/latest/download/ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst)
else
    url="https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/download/v${P_ollamaVersion}/ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst"
fi
version=$(printf '%s\n' "$url" | sed -n 's|.*/download/v\([^/]*\)/.*|\1|p')
[ -n "$version" ] || { echo "Could not work out which Ollama version to download."; exit 1; }
# A half-finished download of a different version is thrown away, not resumed.
if [ -f ollama.version ] && [ "$(cat ollama.version)" != "$version" ]; then rm -f ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst; fi
echo "$version" > ollama.version
echo "Downloading Ollama $version"
# Progress is thinned out so the log stays small; curl resumes a partial file (-C -).
curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 --progress-bar -C - -o ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst "$url" 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | awk 'NR % 40 == 0'
sha=$(sha256sum ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "$sha" > ollama.sha256
echo "sha256 $sha"
if [ -n "$P_ollamaSha256" ] && [ "$sha" != "$P_ollamaSha256" ]; then
    echo "The download does not match the expected checksum. Not installing it."
    rm -f ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst
    exit 1
fi
zstd -t -q ollama-linux-amd64.tar.zst
echo "Download complete."

steps.title: Unpack Ollama into /usr/local
steps.why: Puts the ollama program in /usr/local/bin and its libraries in /usr/local/lib/ollama, where Ollama's own installer puts them.

steps.title: Create the ollama system user
steps.why: The service runs as its own unprivileged user, as Ollama's instructions set it up. Your user joins its group so you can read its files.
steps.run:
useradd -r -s /bin/false -U -m -d /usr/share/ollama ollama
if getent group render >/dev/null 2>&1; then usermod -a -G render ollama; fi
if getent group video >/dev/null 2>&1; then usermod -a -G video ollama; fi
usermod -a -G ollama "$P_USER"
steps.undo:
userdel ollama 2>/dev/null || true
groupdel ollama 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf /usr/share/ollama

steps.title: Create the Ollama service
steps.why: A systemd service starts Ollama at boot and restarts it if it stops.
steps.run:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Ollama Service
After=network-online.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/ollama serve
User=ollama
Group=ollama
Restart=always
RestartSec=3
Environment="PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
chmod 644 /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service
touch "$P_J/restart-needed"
steps.undo:
systemctl disable --now ollama 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service
systemctl daemon-reload

steps.title: Write llmwizard's settings for Ollama
steps.why: Keeps Ollama listening only on this machine, sets how much conversation it remembers and how long a model stays loaded. Stored in its own file so your own changes are never overwritten.
steps.skipIf:
want=$(printf '%s\n' \
    '# Written by llmwizard. Your own settings belong in override.conf, which wins over this file.' \
    '[Service]' \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_HOST=$P_bind\"" \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=$P_contextLength\"" \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=$P_keepAlive\"")
[ "$(cat /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/10-llmwizard.conf 2>/dev/null)" = "$want" ]
steps.run:
want=$(printf '%s\n' \
    '# Written by llmwizard. Your own settings belong in override.conf, which wins over this file.' \
    '[Service]' \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_HOST=$P_bind\"" \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=$P_contextLength\"" \
    "Environment=\"OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=$P_keepAlive\"")
mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d
tmp=$(mktemp)
printf '%s\n' "$want" > "$tmp"
install -o0 -g0 -m644 "$tmp" /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/10-llmwizard.conf
rm -f "$tmp"
touch "$P_J/restart-needed"
echo "Settings written."

steps.title: Start Ollama and turn it on at boot
steps.why: Loads the new settings and starts the service.
steps.skipIf: systemctl is-active --quiet ollama && systemctl is-enabled --quiet ollama && [ ! -f "$P_J/restart-needed" ]
steps.run:
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable ollama
systemctl restart ollama
rm -f "$P_J/restart-needed"
steps.verify:
case "$P_bind" in 0.0.0.0:*) api="127.0.0.1:${P_bind##*:}";; *) api="$P_bind";; esac
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do curl -fsS -m 2 "http://$api/api/version" >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done
exit 1
steps.facts:
case "$P_bind" in 0.0.0.0:*) api="127.0.0.1:${P_bind##*:}";; *) api="$P_bind";; esac
printf 'ollama.apiVersion=%s\n' "$(curl -fsS -m 3 "http://$api/api/version" | sed -n 's/.*"version":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')"

steps.title: Download the model
steps.why: Models are large; this runs in the background on the server and survives your phone disconnecting.
steps.skipIf:
case "$P_bind" in 0.0.0.0:*) api="127.0.0.1:${P_bind##*:}";; *) api="$P_bind";; esac
curl -fsS -m 10 "http://$api/api/show" -d "{\"model\":\"$P_model\"}" >/dev/null 2>&1
steps.run:
case "$P_bind" in 0.0.0.0:*) api="127.0.0.1:${P_bind##*:}";; *) api="$P_bind";; esac
echo "Downloading $P_model"
curl -sS -N "http://$api/api/pull" -d "{\"model\":\"$P_model\"}" | awk '/"error"/ { print; err=1; next } { if (++n % 50 == 1 || /success/) print } END { exit err }'
steps.verify:
case "$P_bind" in 0.0.0.0:*) api="127.0.0.1:${P_bind##*:}";; *) api="$P_bind";; esac
curl -fsS -m 10 "http://$api/api/show" -d "{\"model\":\"$P_model\"}" >/dev/null
